label: Lake
value: A small lake about 400 m long and 250 m wide, traversed by the Gabral River
quote: Kharkhari (also spelled Karkaray) is a small lake in Gabral Valley, about 400 m long and 250 m wide. It is traversed by the Gabral River.

label: Getting there
value: A road runs beside the river up the valley to about 2 km below the lake
quote: A road runs parallel to the river for about 14 km, until 2 km below Lake Kharkhari.

label: From Gabral
value: The lake is 16 km north of the town of Gabral
quote: 16 km north of the town of Gabral

label: From Kalam
value: Gabral is about 20 km north of Kalam by road
quote: about 20 km north (by road) from Kalam

label: Gabral town
value: Gabral town, the valley's lower end, is at about 2,290 m

label: The valley
value: The valley covers about 38,733 hectares (387.33 km2)
